scope: Real original bootstrap Awake, UIRoot Start and open/init/outlet/canvas/animation/close lifecycle; platform height injected, page business hooks/provider isolated, no production account/native bundles
checks: Original bootstrap Awake publishes source display settings and binds original camera
Native module finds tagged canvas/camera and persists root before initialization completes
Root callback assigns module canvas before native bangs Start
Real page binds all thirteen original root outlets
Opening animation waits while paused and retains initialized page/resources
Native Start applies source pixel conversion after bootstrap/root setup even while timeScale is zero
Real OpenUI follows live initialized sorted page
Source initialization and OpenLater run in order across actual animation coroutine
Hide occurs with disposed flag while native object still exists
Dispose clears references before deferred native destruction and resource releases
Close notification follows actual native destruction and all handle releases
Second end-of-frame occurs after hide/dispose frame
Real close releases main, dynamic and custom handles in order
